ticketTitle: CH-04 — Worker agent loop: MCP-client chat consumer
goal: Consume the chat-turns.fifo queue in the Python worker fleet and actually answer an "Ask Sayre" turn: run a bounded LangGraph agent loop that reaches the code graph exclusively through Core's MCP gateway as a real MCP client (bearer = the CH-01 ephemeral credential minted at enqueue time), synthesize a markdown answer with citations and the 70x token-KPI metrics through the existing ModelProvider boundary, publish chat.turn.progress / chat.turn.completed / chat.turn.error events onto Redis pub/sub for CH-05's gateway fan-out, and persist the terminal assistant turn in Postgres.
